caption: The drawing depicts a single figurine of a person, posed as if walking, set against a plain beige background. The figure wears a tall, rounded helmet or cap with a decorative top and patterns in blue and brown tones. The face of the figure is detailed with visible eyes, nose, and a mustache, and the skin is a light peach color. The upper garment is a long, brown coat with lighter brown cuffs and collar, fastened with buttons down the front, and the figure's right hand is tucked into the coat's pocket. The trousers are primarily a faded yellow-brown color with patches and signs of wear, and the boots are high and dark brown. Behind the figure, a curved, metallic support juts out from the back of the calf, connecting to the heel below, suggesting it is part of a functional or decorative object. The entire object is painted to give a sense of three-dimensionality and texture, with some areas showing signs of worn paint.
title: Andiron (Marching Hessian)
